item.name: Bleed Status
item.cardSummary: Classic DoT debuff that punishes movement and stops passive healing until you stop and recover.
item.primaryEffect: Stops HP regen and deals 2 damage per stack.
item.recovery: Heal by sitting, laying down, or standing still; moving blocks healing.
item.commonSources: Melee bites, breath abilities, Bad Omen proc

item.name: Burn Status
item.cardSummary: Heat DoT that ramps regen loss with stacks and often pairs with Ashy Lungs stamina pressure.
item.primaryEffect: Scales HP regen debuff by 10% per stack (10 stacks disables regen); deals 0.025% max HP every 3s plus 0.1% per extra stack.
item.recovery: Stand still, sit, or lay down; also applies Ashy Lungs.
item.commonSources: Melee burn, Defensive Burn, Fire Breath

item.name: Poison Status
item.cardSummary: Stamina-draining DoT whose real drain is stamina loss per tick, not regen reduction.
item.primaryEffect: Deals 0.2% max HP base plus 0.05% per stack every 3s; drains 0.35% stamina per stack each tick (UI regen text is misleading).
item.recovery: Sit, lay down, or stand still; Muddy doubles heal rate.

item.name: Frostbite Status
item.cardSummary: Cold ailment that taxes hunger, stamina recovery, and bite speed rather than immobilizing you.
item.primaryEffect: +10% hunger drain, -25% stamina regen, and +2.5% bite cooldown per stack.
item.recovery: Standard ailment healing; distinct from Freeze and Hypothermia.
item.commonSources: Seasonal snow, Frostbite Attack, Minty food buff

item.name: Necropoison Status
item.cardSummary: Escalating poison that shifts from visual tint to control inversion and ability lockout.
item.primaryEffect: 1+ stacks tint screen; 7+ adds confusion chance; 10+ disables active abilities (Controls 1–6).

item.name: Injury Status
item.cardSummary: Movement slow that stacks heavily and caps at 99 for long fights.
item.primaryEffect: -0.75% movement speed per stack across walk, sprint, and flight (not jump or dart); cap 99 stacks.
item.commonSources: Melee injury, Earthquake ticks, Bad Omen proc

item.name: Ashy Lungs
item.cardSummary: Burn companion debuff that adds stamina regen pressure on top of burn damage.
item.primaryEffect: -20% stamina regeneration.
item.recovery: Clears when burn and source effects end.
item.commonSources: Burn Status side effect, volcanic eruption disasters

item.name: Bad Omen
item.cardSummary: Regen curse that can explode into another serious ailment if you fail to cleanse it.
item.primaryEffect: -25% health regeneration per stack; when fully healed can proc a random major ailment bundle.
item.recovery: Heal all stacks to avoid random proc.
item.relatedEffects: Bleed, Burn, Frostbite, Poison, and others

item.name: Corrosion Status
item.cardSummary: DoT that also crushes effective weight, making you hit softer and take more from similar-weight foes.
item.primaryEffect: 0.5% max HP tick regardless of stacks; -7% weight base plus -1% per stack up to -97.5% at 90 stacks.
item.recovery: Sit, lay down, or stand still.

item.name: Deep Wounds Status
item.cardSummary: Anti-heal gate that stops bleed recovery until the wound effect clears.
item.primaryEffect: Blocks bleed status healing and regeneration entirely.
item.recovery: Wait for stacks to expire via standard decay.

item.name: Disease Status
item.cardSummary: Sustain debuff that keeps draining needs and regen even if you keep moving.
item.primaryEffect: +1.5% hunger and thirst depletion per stack; -15% HP and stamina regen.

item.name: Drowsy Status
item.cardSummary: Combat slowdown that makes your bites land less often.
item.primaryEffect: Reduces bite attack speed.

item.name: Fear Status
item.cardSummary: Panic debuff that cuts damage but makes you run faster; not the same as Scared.
item.primaryEffect: -45% damage and +35% movement speed.

item.name: Heartbroken Status
item.cardSummary: Anti-support debuff that shuts off outside heals while native regen still works.
item.primaryEffect: Blocks all external healing except native HP regen.

item.name: Radiation Status
item.cardSummary: Low DoT that mainly strips your ailment resistances so other debuffs land harder.
item.primaryEffect: 0.5% max HP tick; reduces positive ailment block % nonlinearly up to 99% at 99 stacks.

item.name: Scared Status
item.cardSummary: Cower-driven debuff with a bigger damage cut and smaller speed boost than Fear.
item.primaryEffect: -50% damage and +25% movement speed; 10 stacks from Cower pose for 10 seconds.
item.stacking: 10 self-applied stacks from pose until movement.
item.recovery: Stacks persist until you move after cowering.

item.name: Sticky Teeth Status
item.cardSummary: Single-application bite slow that cannot be stacked for extra delay.
item.primaryEffect: +65% bite cooldown; does not stack or reapply.

item.name: Blurred Vision
item.cardSummary: Screen blur that makes targeting and awareness harder.
item.primaryEffect: Blurs the player's screen.

item.name: Broken Legs Status
item.cardSummary: Hard mobility lock that removes jump, dart, and flight tools.
item.primaryEffect: Disables dart, jump, and flight.

item.name: Confusion Status
item.cardSummary: Control scramble that flips inputs and movement feel.
item.primaryEffect: Periodically inverts controls and disorients movement.

item.name: Freeze Status
item.cardSummary: Immobilizing cold that grounds flyers and heavily slows ground movement.
item.primaryEffect: Grounds fliers, blocks flight and takeoff, and -75% walk and sprint speed.
item.recovery: Heals over time even while moving.

item.name: Gale Status
item.cardSummary: Knockback-style slow applied after Gale ability contact.
item.primaryEffect: Decreases overall movement speed.

item.name: Inked Status
item.cardSummary: Aquatic vision obscuring effect from Glowleaf contact.
item.primaryEffect: Obfuscates player vision.

item.name: Paralyze Status
item.cardSummary: Root effect that still lets you bite but removes movement and turning.
item.primaryEffect: Freezes target in place for several seconds; attacks still work but movement and turning stop.

item.name: Shock Status
item.cardSummary: Movement jitter debuff that makes precise control unreliable.
item.primaryEffect: Causes erratic, unpredictable movement.

item.name: Shredded Wings
item.cardSummary: Anti-flight debuff that drops airborne targets immediately.
item.primaryEffect: Disables flight and forces flying creatures to drop.

item.name: Slowed Status
item.cardSummary: Flat movement slow applied by abilities and traps.
item.primaryEffect: -20% all movement speed.

item.name: Snow Shield Status
item.cardSummary: Defensive snow field that protects allies but taxes your own hunger and thirst.
item.primaryEffect: +66.7% hunger and thirst drain while inside your own Snow Shield.

item.name: Sticky Tar Status
item.cardSummary: Hardcore realm hazard that grounds and slows like aquatic kelp tar.
item.primaryEffect: Slows movement, prevents takeoff, and disables jumping.

item.name: Sticky Trap Status
item.cardSummary: Trap slow from placed sticky hazards.
item.primaryEffect: Applies a movement slow.

item.name: Stunned
item.cardSummary: Ability lockout that stops active skill use for a short window.
item.primaryEffect: Disables active abilities.

item.name: Tangled Kelp Status
item.cardSummary: Aquatic realm hazard slow from kelp contact.
item.primaryEffect: Decreases movement speed.

item.name: Torn Ligaments
item.cardSummary: Stacking leg injury that slows walking and drains stamina or glide recovery.
item.primaryEffect: -10% stamina and glide regen per stack (up to 10); -50% walk speed while any stacks remain.
item.recovery: Stacks decay naturally over time without sitting.

item.name: Tunnel Vision
item.cardSummary: Peripheral vision loss that narrows what you can see on screen.
item.primaryEffect: Darkens screen edges.

item.name: Urchin Sickness
item.cardSummary: Aquatic hazard that blocks all food and water intake until cleared.
item.primaryEffect: Prevents eating and drinking.
item.recovery: Standard ailment healing after leaving urchins.

item.name: Adrenaline
item.cardSummary: High-risk burst buff that trades stamina regen for damage and speed.
item.primaryEffect: Increases damage and movement speed while disabling stamina regeneration.

item.name: Aggressive
item.cardSummary: Self-applied combat buff from holding Aggressive pose without moving.
item.primaryEffect: +25% damage and -50% stamina regen; 10 stacks from Aggressive pose for 10 seconds until movement.
item.recovery: Stacks freeze until you move after aggroing.

item.name: Amped Status
item.cardSummary: Instant stamina refill plus regen and speed boost.
item.primaryEffect: +50% stamina regen, +10% speed, and instant +25% max stamina on apply.

item.name: Blessing's Boon
item.cardSummary: Support mark buff that adds stamina upfront and sustained healing over time.
item.primaryEffect: Instant +25% stamina on apply; restores 15% HP over stack duration; duration stacks, stamina grant does not.

item.name: Cocoon Rage
item.cardSummary: Post-cocoon damage spike reward for finishing the defensive phase.
item.primaryEffect: +15% damage dealt when Cocooned Status expires.

item.name: Damage Link Status
item.cardSummary: Soul-link buff that mirrors damage and healing between linked targets.
item.primaryEffect: Links two creatures so all damage and healing received is shared.

item.name: Defensive Status
item.cardSummary: Short weight boost for absorbing hits and winning weight trades.
item.primaryEffect: +10% weight.

item.name: Escape Area Status
item.cardSummary: Emergency mobility buff from the Escape Area active ability.
item.primaryEffect: Greatly increases speed and stamina regeneration.

item.name: Fortify Status
item.cardSummary: Cleanse plus short immunity window; does not block hunger, thirst, plushie, or weather effects.
item.primaryEffect: Brief immunity to most incoming ailments after cleansing existing debuffs.

item.name: Harden Status
item.cardSummary: Tank mode that trades speed for weight and regen.
item.primaryEffect: Slows user but increases weight and HP regeneration.

item.name: Hunters Curse Status
item.cardSummary: High-damage curse buff that doubles outgoing damage.
item.primaryEffect: Doubles damage output.

item.name: Lich Mark Status
item.cardSummary: Setup mark that converts into ally buff or enemy debuff depending on caster.
item.primaryEffect: Indicator mark that swaps into Blessing's Boon or Malice's Mark when the marker attacks.
item.recovery: Removed when replaced by follow-up mark.

item.name: Life Leech Status
item.cardSummary: Sustain buff that turns damage dealt into self-healing.
item.primaryEffect: Outgoing attacks heal the user for a portion of damage dealt.

item.name: Malice's Mark
item.cardSummary: Offensive mark debuff that drains stamina and cuts damage on the marked target.
item.primaryEffect: Instant -25% stamina on apply; -15% damage while afflicted; duration stacks, effect values do not.

item.name: Reflect Status
item.cardSummary: Melee mirror buff that sends plain bite damage back to attackers.
item.primaryEffect: Reflects direct melee damage to attacker; white shield indicator; no DoT or breath reflect.

item.name: Speed Blitz Status
item.cardSummary: Short mobility burst with stamina recovery and ground speed.
item.primaryEffect: +30% stamina regen and +25% walk and sprint speed.

item.name: Speed Gift Status
item.cardSummary: Balanced speed gift covering ground and flight movement.
item.primaryEffect: +20% stamina regen, walk, sprint, and flight speed.

item.name: Tail Dropped
item.cardSummary: Escape tradeoff that makes you faster but much lighter and easier to knock around.
item.primaryEffect: +35% walk and run speed but -40% weight after Tail Drop.

item.name: Unbridled Rage Status
item.cardSummary: Damage spike that shuts off stamina regen until rage stacks clear.
item.primaryEffect: +30% damage while stamina regeneration is disabled for as long as stacks remain.

item.name: Warden's Rage Status
item.cardSummary: Low-health berserk mode that trades healing for stamina and scaling damage.
item.primaryEffect: Disables HP regen, boosts stamina regen, and increases damage as health falls.

item.name: Clean Water Status
item.cardSummary: Baseline hydration buff from standard clean water.
item.primaryEffect: Reduces hunger and thirst drain while boosting stamina and HP regen after drinking clean water.

item.name: Cocooned Status
item.cardSummary: Full damage immunity phase during cocoon transformation.
item.primaryEffect: Grants damage immunity while cocooned.
item.recovery: Break cocoon to exit; triggers Cocoon Rage.

item.name: Cocooning Status
item.cardSummary: Setup phase that slows you while the protective cocoon forms.
item.primaryEffect: Slows the player while building a cocoon.

item.name: Enriched Status
item.cardSummary: Stamina sustain food buff with a long stack timer you can refresh.
item.primaryEffect: +25% stamina and stamina regen; 300-stack timer refreshable.

item.name: Gestation
item.cardSummary: Nesting speed helper for faster egg development.
item.primaryEffect: +2.5% egg gestation speed; still helps if base speed is 0.

item.name: Healing Pulse Status
item.cardSummary: Flat HP tick boost that behaves differently from a simple regen percentage buff.
item.primaryEffect: Adds flat +7% max HP per health tick on top of native regen after multipliers; still works when regen is blocked by bleed or burn.

item.name: Migration Region Status
item.cardSummary: Regional growth boost tied to the migration map zone.
item.primaryEffect: Increases growth speed and nest egg generation inside the Migration Region.

item.name: Muddy Status
item.cardSummary: Mud sustain buff that accelerates bleed and poison recovery.
item.primaryEffect: +25% HP regen and doubles poison and bleed heal rate.
item.recovery: Standard ailment healing; mud wallow speeds recovery.

item.name: Newborn Status
item.cardSummary: Post-nest recovery buff for the parent creature.
item.primaryEffect: +50% HP regen and reduced hunger and thirst loss for the mother after hatching.

item.name: Pack Banner Protection
item.cardSummary: Den-based damage reduction for allied packmates.
item.primaryEffect: -5% additional damage taken for packmates inside your pack den.

item.name: Pack Forager
item.cardSummary: Forager role that triples how many resources you can haul.
item.primaryEffect: Increases resource carry limit from 1 to 3.
item.relatedEffects: Pack Guard, Pack Oracle, Pack Scout

item.name: Pack Guard
item.cardSummary: Guard role that trades speed for heavier, tankier defense.
item.primaryEffect: Increases defense by raising weight while lowering speed.
item.relatedEffects: Pack Forager, Pack Oracle, Pack Scout

item.name: Pack Migration Status
item.cardSummary: Pack-wide regen boost during migration zone travel.
item.primaryEffect: Boosts HP and stamina regen when your pack is inside the Migration Region.

item.name: Pack Oracle
item.cardSummary: Oracle role for shared scent intel across the pack.
item.primaryEffect: Lets you see what other packmates are sniffing.

item.name: Pack Scout
item.cardSummary: Scout role for faster movement and wider scent range.
item.primaryEffect: Increased movement speed and sniff range.

item.name: Refreshed Status
item.cardSummary: Premium water drink bonus for extra HP recovery.
item.primaryEffect: +5% HP regeneration after drinking water above 90% quality.

item.name: Resting Status
item.cardSummary: Den rest buff that supercharges passive healing on Bedding.
item.primaryEffect: +50% passive HP regen while laying on Bedding den item.

item.name: Satiated Status
item.cardSummary: Core food sustain buff that slows hunger and speeds growth.
item.primaryEffect: -30% hunger drain and +50% growth speed.

item.name: Scent Hidden
item.cardSummary: Stealth buff that keeps you off enemy scent reads.
item.primaryEffect: Prevents detection through scent controls.

item.name: Sea School Status
item.cardSummary: Aquatic school buff for low-tier creatures staying near packmates.
item.primaryEffect: Applies buffs near Tier 1 and 2 packmates while you are Tier 1 or 2 in Aquatic Realm.
item.recovery: Leave school formation or change tier.

item.name: Spring Water Status
item.cardSummary: Photovore specialty water buff with growth and stamina perks.
item.primaryEffect: Photovore-only magical water buff: lower thirst drain and growth time with higher stamina and regen.

item.name: Stamina Boost
item.cardSummary: World puddle buff for faster stamina recovery.
item.primaryEffect: Increases stamina regeneration from Stamina Puddles.

item.name: Survival Boost
item.cardSummary: General sustain reward that slows hunger and thirst drain.
item.primaryEffect: -20% hunger and thirst depletion.

item.name: Territory Status
item.cardSummary: Territory sustain buff that makes food last longer at home.
item.primaryEffect: Reduces hunger drain while inside your pack Territory.

item.name: Water Regeneration
item.cardSummary: Passive thirst refill effect separate from drinking water buffs.
item.primaryEffect: Regenerates the thirst meter over time.

item.name: Aftershock
item.cardSummary: Earthquake follow-up debuff that cuts damage and stamina recovery.
item.primaryEffect: -20% damage and -50% stamina regen per stack.

item.name: Hungry Status
item.cardSummary: Starvation damage when hunger runs out.
item.primaryEffect: Causes damage from starvation.

item.name: Sickly Status
item.cardSummary: Food-poisoning debuff from bad food or water that drains needs faster.
item.primaryEffect: +20% hunger and thirst depletion, -20% stamina and HP regen.
item.recovery: Standard ailment healing; avoid rotten food and dirty water.

item.name: Stolen Speed Status
item.cardSummary: Inverse of Speed Gift that slows and drains stamina recovery.
item.primaryEffect: -20% stamina regen, walk, sprint, and flight speed.

item.name: Sugar Rush
item.cardSummary: Plushie-linked plant buff that favors gliders with faster flight recovery.
item.primaryEffect: Increases glide regen and flight speed when eating plants with Momo plushie equipped.

item.name: Thirsty Status
item.cardSummary: Dehydration damage when thirst runs out.
item.primaryEffect: Causes damage from dehydration.

item.name: Acid Rain
item.cardSummary: Shelter-or-die weather that mixes HP chunks with poison stacks.
item.primaryEffect: 3% HP damage and 2 poison stacks per tick unless sheltered; can poison water sources.
item.stacking: While exposed under acid rain clouds.
item.commonSources: Acid Rain weather, Acid Rain Summon Token

item.name: Blood Moon
item.cardSummary: Night disaster that supercharges combat stats for every creature.
item.primaryEffect: +50% damage, +50% stamina regen, and +50% bite speed for all creatures during the disaster.

item.name: Blue Moon
item.cardSummary: Rare calm moon weather that buffs recovery and softens damage.
item.primaryEffect: +50% HP and stamina regen, -50% damage, and immunity to juvenile creatures (under age 33).

item.name: Corruption
item.cardSummary: Event corruption ailment from tainted resources and corrupted world objects.
item.primaryEffect: -10% HP regen per stack plus damage per tick from corrupted food, water, NPCs, or growth destruction.
item.recovery: Leave corrupted zone and heal stacks.

item.name: Day/Night Time Status
item.cardSummary: Photovore diet cycle buff by day and penalty by night.
item.primaryEffect: Day: +5% damage, +25% stamina regen, -10% growth time, +15% HP regen for photovores/photocarnivores. Night: -5% damage, -25% stamina regen, -15% HP regen.

item.name: Heat Wave
item.cardSummary: Hot weather parallel to acid rain that applies burn instead of poison.
item.primaryEffect: 1% HP damage and 2 burn stacks per tick unless sheltered or Volcanic type; water in cold biomes helps.

item.name: Hypothermia
item.cardSummary: Blizzard exposure debuff distinct from ability frostbite or freeze immobilize.
item.primaryEffect: -98% stamina regen and 0.75% HP drain during blizzards unless sheltered; laying stops HP loss.
item.recovery: Enter shelter; blizzard must end for full stamina recovery.

item.name: Love Struck
item.cardSummary: Valentines event vision tint from player-thrown arrows.
item.primaryEffect: Applies a pink vignette to vision.

item.name: Minty
item.cardSummary: Event food buff that adds frostbite-on-bite pressure while it lasts.
item.primaryEffect: +1 Frostbite Attack stack per bite while active; fully consumed food leaves nothing.

item.name: Rain Ailment
item.cardSummary: Rain flying tax that makes takeoff harder and boosts water interaction.
item.primaryEffect: +15% takeoff multiplier, +50% water source interaction, and prevents moisture loss (since Sep 2024).

item.name: Spicy
item.cardSummary: Seasonal event food buff from spicy candy treats.
item.primaryEffect: Event candy buff from spicy seasonal food.
item.commonSources: Spicy candy, candy cane event food

item.name: Star Speed
item.cardSummary: Winter event speed pickup with tier-scaling movement bonus.
item.primaryEffect: 3 stacks on golden star contact; +25% speed T1–3, +35% T4, +45% T5 walk/sprint/run.
